crossRefs.note: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: in the place where the burnt offering is…
The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the Tent of Meeting.
He shall kill the male lamb in the place where they kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the…

translations.web: “ ‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.
translations.bsb: The guilt offering is like the sin offering; the same law applies to both. It belongs to the priest who makes atonement with it.
translations.kjv: As the sin offering is, so is the trespass offering: there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement
translations.asv: As is the sin-offering, so is the trespass-offering; there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith, he shall have it.
